subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted outbound message account selection change from documented default-account fallback to enabled-account inference when exactly one account is enabled and configured?
rationale: The desired fix improves message delivery DX but changes fallback behavior in a compatibility-sensitive channel/account path, so maintainer intent is needed before landing the open PR or a replacement.

options.title: Adopt shared enabled-account inference
options.body: Use the shared resolver approach from the linked candidate PR, after rebase, proof, and docs/tests, while preserving explicit/default/bound account precedence.

options.title: Preserve current fallback contract
options.body: Keep defaultAccount/first-account fallback behavior and require explicit accountId or defaultAccount configuration for multi-account proactive sends.

options.title: Narrow the policy before implementation
options.body: Ask for a more constrained rule, such as only fail-closed on disabled defaults or only infer for selected channel plugins with proven safe semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared enabled-account inference
recommendation.body: Use the shared resolver approach from the linked candidate PR, after rebase, proof, and docs/tests, while preserving explicit/default/bound account precedence.
